name: Megamind Peeking
look: A low-angle close-up of Megamind, the blue-skinned alien with a huge bald head, peering down into the frame with wide green eyes, raised brows and a slight pout. The dim background shows dark metal walls and spikes.
use: Megamind peers down skeptically, usually under a caption in the form "No [thing]?" that mocks someone for lacking something. It also works as a curious or judgmental peek at any situation.
slots: top caption: 'No [thing]?' or the question he is asking
describe: blue alien with a big head peeking down at the camera
megamind staring with raised eyebrows from above
blue cartoon villain face leaning into the frame
megamind face used for no blank question memes
origin: A close-up of the title character from the 2010 DreamWorks animated film Megamind.
